jobs.name: Gale Slugs
jobs.prompt:
Generate a production sprite animation sheet for the vertical arcade shooter Bullets of Fury. Use the attached existing weapon badges ONLY as identity, material and emerald Wind palette references. Create actual unframed combat projectile sprites, no badges. Exactly 16 genuinely drawn consecutive animation poses in a strict 4 columns by 4 rows grid, read left to right then down. Square 1024 x 1024 transparent sheet, equal 256 x 256 cells, empty transparent gutters. HD Neo Geo inspired detailed pixel art: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, bright emerald green and near-white Wind energy, dark readable outlines, preserve silver/gray metal where present. One continuous seamless 16-pose flight/held loop, not 4 separate sequences. Keep the physical projectile/core/nozzle locked at precisely the SAME coordinate and SAME scale in all cells. Only the energy curls, wind ribbons, sparks and internal lighting animate; no camera movement, no per-frame zoom, no displaced sprite. All directional sprites point straight NORTH (up), never diagonally. Complete silhouettes and contained effects, at least 16 pixels empty safety padding. No labels, frame numbers, grid lines, backgrounds, ships, tanks, UI, weapons or extra objects.
Subject: Reference top-left badge: a SINGLE silver machine-gun bullet, upright north. The metal bullet has a rounded pointed nose, sharp gray outline, and one compact emerald corkscrew wind trail coiling down behind it. Lock the solid metal body at cell center x=128, y=104, with its lower body attachment at y=132. Body unchanged across all frames; animate a complete rotation of the emerald spiral behind it. Never draw two bullets in one cell.
